description: This file defines the 'Loop' class, which implements a loop operation for a mini-language within the OFBiz framework. It handles execution of a loop based on a count expression, manages sub-operations, and supports control flow exceptions like break and continue.

classes.name: Loop
classes.description: Implements a loop operation for the mini-language, executing sub-operations a specified number of times based on a dynamic count expression.

classes.name: Loop.LoopFactory
classes.description: Factory class to create instances of the Loop operation from XML elements.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the loop operation, expanding the count expression, iterating, and executing sub-operations with control flow handling.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the loop element with its attributes.

methods.name: createMethodOperation
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a Loop object from an XML element.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name identifier for the factory, 'loop'.
